feeds.title: Cruise Law News
feeds.description: Telling everything the cruise lines don't want you to know is the motto of this maritime law blog authored by Miami lawyer Jim Walker. Cruise Law News aims to discuss incidents at sea on cruise ships and in ports of call and to educate the public about the legal rights of cruise ship passengers and crew members. We also address cruise ship safety, security, crime on ships, cruise industry financial issues, and environmental issues

feeds.title: Leesfield & Partners Blogs » Cruise Ship Lawyers
feeds.description: The blog published by Leesfield Scolaro covers topics like Cruise Ship Litigation, Wrongful Death, passenger rights, etc. Leesfield Scolaro serves as a leading personal injury trial law firm and dedicates its practice to handling cases involving personal injury, airplane crashes, negligent security, travel and resort injuries, product defects, medical malpractice, and nursing home litigation.

feeds.title: Victory Travel & Cruise Lawyers Blog
feeds.description: Our travel accidents lawyer blog has expert views, tips and legal updates about cruising, air travel, consumer rights and more. Victory Travel & Cruise Lawyers is a new law firm specialising in bringing compensation claims for people injured overseas, in aircraft accidents, and in cruise ship accidents.
